description: Semantic search over the session ledger's EVENT-CONTENT embeddings (LED-01): the raw USER/ASSISTANT message text itself, chunk-granular, in the session_ledger_event vector namespace. Complements search_sessions, which searches lossy M6 session summaries — use search_event_content when the phrase you want lives inside a conversation message rather than in a one-paragraph session summary. Filters: query (required, natural-language); limit (1..50, default 10). Returns top-k event chunks joined back to their session_ledger__event rows, ordered by embedding cosine similarity descending; each result carries the list_events_by_source_window event envelope (event_id, session_id, sequence, event_at, role, content_text, vendor, source_kind) plus chunk_index and score. Coverage note: only events already embedded by the embed_missing_event_content producer (or its scheduled drain) are reachable — an un-embedded event is invisible to this verb, not an error. Scope: USER/ASSISTANT MESSAGE events with inline content, excluding tool traffic, system events, and internal-thinking subtypes (Codex reasoning).
embedding_description: Search the actual message text of past LLM conversations — the raw words a user or assistant wrote inside a session — by meaning. Chunk-level semantic lookup over per-event content embeddings, returning the matching events with their session ids, timestamps, roles, and similarity scores. Finds a phrase buried mid-conversation that a session-level summary would have dropped.
